Start date: 1056-11-12.  
Subtract 50 weeks = 50 × 7 = 350 days.  
Plus 6 days = total 356 days subtracted.  

1056-11-12 minus 356 days:  
Subtract 356 days from 1056-11-12.  
First go to 1056-01-01: from Nov 12 back 316 days (Jan 31 days + Feb 29 (leap) + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 30 + Oct 31 + 12 days in Nov = 316).  
356 − 316 = 40 more days back into 1055.  
1056 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not century exception in Gregorian proleptic? 1056 mod 4 = 0, year>1582 rule not needed here, treat as leap).  
From 1055-12-31 back 40 days: Dec 31 back 1 day = Dec 30, back 30 more days = Nov 30, back 9 more days = Nov 21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1055-11-21
